title: Fable 5 Agentic OS is Insane... just watch
description:
📈 ALL Systems: https://bit.ly/4kol0y5
🎙️ Glaido: https://bit.ly/4eGoI3R
🩵 Free Resources: https://bit.ly/3RNNDLa

Fable 5 is the most powerful model we've got right now, and in this one I show you how to build an agentic operating system around it across five levels. We add Fable 5 to a Claude Code setup, connect a shared memory so Claude and Hermes both know what's happening, and get it dreaming for you overnight. There's a Ministry of Agents section where Fable 5 orchestrates DeepSeek, GLM and GPT models to debate and give you a better answer, all cached to save tokens. We even build an interactive voice interface that follows you around the OS. Genuinely useful stuff you can copy straight in.

*Core Software*
☁️ Claude: https://claude.ai/
🔀 OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/
🐳 DeepSeek: https://www.deepseek.com/
🚀 AntiGravity: https://antigravity.google/

01:11 - Why You Need Unified Memory

03:00 - Adding Fable 5 In Hermes
05:22 - Finding Skills You're Missing
07:32 - Level Two: One Brain
09:00 - Improving The Memory System

12:26 - Fable 5 As Orchestrator
14:48 - Level Four: Dreaming Overnight

17:22 - Building The Voice Line
17:56 - Live Status Report Demo

Build a Claude Code agentic operating system with Fable 5, unified memory across Hermes and Claude, a Ministry of Agents mixture of experts running DeepSeek V4, GLM 5.2 and GPT 5.5 through OpenRouter, plus overnight dreaming and a voice interface.
#Fable5 #ClaudeCode #AgenticOS #AIAgents #HermesAgent #OpenRouter
